title: Arkham nine-character ward stress
intent: Large-cast perception and continuity stress: mixed security, clinical, and patient voices under rumor of a perimeter alert; no scripted outcomes.
opening_description: Late evening on Arkham's secure clinical wing: fluorescent hum, locked doors, a smell of disinfectant and old stone. Staff and high-profile patients are clustered after a partial lockdown drill—radios crackle with conflicting fragments about a fence alarm. Dr. Arkham and Dr. Karlsson try to hold order; Cash keeps a hand near his belt; Selina, Ivy, Harley, Magpie, Nocturna, and Jane Doe are present under escort or observation, each with different privileges and grudges. Nobody has been shown full incident video yet.
trigger_text: A PA line cuts in mid-sentence—static, then silence. Cash snaps, 'Nobody moves until we know if that was a test or a breach.' Ivy murmurs something only Selina is close enough to catch. Harley grins like she heard anyway. Arkham: 'We need one clear chain of fact. Who was where when the alarm tripped?'

seed_issue.description: Conflicting partial information about a perimeter or lockdown event; staff must assert control while patients test boundaries.
